items.author: Michael McCusker, Oct 24
items.summary: Row-level security with Tableau 2026.2's composable data sources: publish the data, publish an entitlement table with the RLS calc, compose the two, add the RLS filter, then publish or embed. He also covers two common mistakes and a known bug in 2026.3.0.

items.author: Mohammad Afzal K., Oct 24
items.summary: Power Viz, a free preview VS Code extension he built with Patrick Leung that treats Power BI reports as code. It previews .pbix files offline, edits them through Claude or Copilot, shows visual and DAX diffs, and deploys to Power BI or Fabric.
